scientific_fallback_and_triangulation_no: Live calls to agriculturalunderstanding.googleapis.com return HTTP 403 PERMISSION_DENIED when no ANTHROKRISHI_API_KEY is present in the environment. To preserve full scientific integrity without fabricating field polygons, the pipeline (1) provides the complete S2 Level-13 stratified client and cache ready for key injection, (2) extracts real primary mapped minor irrigation waterbodies/farm ponds/tanks from the India-WRIS District Water Body Atlas (DWA Ph1/Ph2) and Artificial Recharge Structures (ARS), and (3) reconstructs sub-basin agricultural crop areas, cropping intensity, crop transitions, and FAO-56 green/blue crop water consumption from official DES/ICRISAT/CWC/NRSC LULC datasets (2000-01 to 2025-26).
